title: From static markup to editable content
subtitle: Traditional CMSes make you design the database first and bend the UI to fit. devgon inverts it - the admin panel becomes a structured mirror of whatever UI you already built.

items.title: Build the UI freely
items.description: No templates, no theme system, no constraints. Next.js, Tailwind and whatever the design needs.

items.title: Declare what is editable
items.description: Wrap a section in ContentCardManager, name the fields and their limits. That is the entire integration.

items.title: The backend just stores it
items.description: One universal Content entity absorbs every section site-wide. New field, new section - no migration.

items.title: Fetch via GraphQL with ISR
items.description: Pages are statically generated and cached by tag, with JSON fallbacks so the site renders even if the backend is down.

items.title: Edit live, revalidate instantly
items.description: Saving in the panel triggers on-demand revalidation of exactly the pages that use that content key.
